difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the properties of the diagonal of a morphism of algebraic stacks can be read off from a smooth presentation of the source (author lemma at source lines 4073-4091, label lemma-properties-diagonal-from-presentation). The comparison of the two diagonals through the presentation is the substance. H3.
